name: kaiva-postgres-mcp
description: Read-only access to a PostgreSQL database for Gemini CLI: the maintained drop-in replacement for the archived server-postgres. Set the database URL once with: gemini extensions config kaiva-postgres-mcp

settings.name: Database URL
settings.description: PostgreSQL connection URL, for example postgresql://user:password@localhost:5432/mydb. A login that can only read is best.
